#!/bin/ash
# PotenFYR Studios Universal Programming Language Installer
apk add --no-cache curl git ca-certificates
INSTALL_DIR="/mnt/server"
[ ! -d "${INSTALL_DIR}" ] && INSTALL_DIR="${PWD}"
cd "${INSTALL_DIR}" || exit 1
if [ -n "${GIT_REPO:-}" ]; then
    echo "[potenfyr] Cloning repository: ${GIT_REPO}..."
    AUTH_URL="${GIT_REPO}"
    [ -n "${GIT_AUTH_TOKEN:-}" ] && [[ "${GIT_REPO}" =~ ^https:// ]] && AUTH_URL="https://${GIT_AUTH_TOKEN}@${GIT_REPO#https://}"
    git clone --branch "${GIT_BRANCH:-main}" --depth 1 "${AUTH_URL}" . || git clone --depth 1 "${AUTH_URL}" . || true
fi
chown -R 988:988 "${INSTALL_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || chown -R 1000:1000 "${INSTALL_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || chmod -R 777 "${INSTALL_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "[potenfyr][✓] Installation complete. Workspace ready."
